item.title: Jade quality assessment includes transparency and texture
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Transparency and texture, along with color, help evaluate jadeite jade; these terms describe appearance, not proof of treatment.
EXIMUTC view: Confirm the material is jadeite or nephrite and request any enhancement disclosures before comparing prices.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/jade-quality-factor

item.title: Sapphire evaluation combines color and treatment
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: The appearance of sapphire depends on color, clarity and cut; some stones are treated.
EXIMUTC view: A trade color label does not replace a proper laboratory report.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/sapphire-quality-factor
